name: piston-retract-unpowered
comment: Retraction without redstone: heads (34) and the blocks in front are placed at t=0, then at t=2 extended pistons (meta | 8) are placed behind them with set_block_silent. BlockPistonBase.onBlockAdded runs updatePistonState, which finds the piston unpowered but extended and runs playBlock(1): the piston becomes a moving block (36) carrying itself back, then a plain piston removes its head; a sticky one pulls the block two cells ahead (stone, wool with meta 14, an unpowered piston) into the head's cell, and only removes the head when that block is air, obsidian or a pumpkin (destroy-by-push blocks are not pulled). Cases: (-4,61,0) plain up; (-4,62,4) plain down; (0,61,0) sticky up + stone; (3,61,0) sticky +x + obsidian; (3,61,4) sticky +x + wool; (0,61,-3) sticky -z + air; (3,61,-4) sticky +x + piston; (3,61,8) sticky +x + pumpkin. The TileEntityPiston moves land on the third tile-entity update.
